map.训练算力需求估算器，用 Kaplan 缩放律由参数量与训练 token 数估算总: A training compute estimator using the Kaplan scaling law to estimate total training FLOPs from parameter count and training tokens, supporting compute planning.
map.训练 FLOPs ≈ 6·N·D（N 为参数量，D 为训练 token 数）；训: Training FLOPs ≈ 6·N·D (N parameters, D training tokens); training months ≈ 6ND / (GPU count × per-GPU compute × 3600 × 24 × 30)
map.Transformer 训练的经验法则：前向 2N、反向约 4N，合计每 tok: The rule of thumb for Transformer training: forward 2N, backward about 4N, totalling about 6N FLOPs per token—the basis of the Chinchilla-family scaling law. Dividing by effective cluster compute (multiply by MFU, typically 30%–50%) gives the training period.
map.Kaplan 缩放律：训练 FLOPs≈6·N·D，N 为参数量、D 为训练 t: Kaplan scaling law: training FLOPs≈6·N·D, with N parameters and D training tokens.
map.前向约 2ND、反向约 4ND，合计 6ND；用于大模型算力与时间表规划。: Forward about 2ND, backward about 4ND, totalling 6ND; used for large-model compute and schedule planning.
map.实际受并行效率、通信与显存限制，理论值需乘开销系数。: Real runs are limited by parallel efficiency, communication and memory, so theoretical values need an overhead factor.
: N=7×10⁹, D=1×10¹² → FLOPs≈6×7e9×1e12=4.2×10²². At 1e15 FLOPs/s (about 1 PFLOPS effective) this needs ≈4.2e7 seconds ≈487 days on a single card; in practice thousand-GPU clusters parallelize and shorten it.
map.6ND 是上限还是典型值？: Is 6ND an upper bound or typical?
map.6ND 是前向+反向的理论下界(理想乘加计数)，实际含激活重算、通信与低效会更高: 6ND is the theoretical lower bound of forward+backward (ideal multiply-add counts); real runs add activation recomputation, communication and inefficiency, so planning with a 1.5~3× margin is safer.
map.参数量和训练数据哪个更耗算力？: Which costs more compute, parameters or data?
map.二者线性相乘，等比例增。但现代训练常'数据受限'，即数据量不足以让参数充分训练，: They multiply linearly, growing proportionally. But modern training is often 'data-limited'—there isn't enough data to train the parameters fully—so adding data beats adding parameters (up to the Chinchilla optimum).
